About This Agency

Located in Everett, Washington, this established ELITE Allstate agency offers a rare opportunity to acquire a well-maintained, 60-year book of business with a strong history of stability. The office space is currently on a month-to-month lease, providing flexibility to renew or relocate to a facility that meets Allstate’s specifications. This Elite agency generates $4.7M in written premium, $643,605 in revenue, services 2,095 policies, and maintains an impressive 87% retention rate.
